modelspec.checkpoint.ParameterPath.title: ParameterPath
modelspec.checkpoint.ParameterPath.description: A stable canonical parameter path such as `TinyMLP.fc1.weight` (DESIGN.md § 2.3).

modelspec.observatory.Histogram.title: Histogram
modelspec.observatory.Histogram.description: The distribution of one tensor's elements in bins; bin i counts the elements in [bin_edges[i], bin_edges[i+1]), so there is one more edge than counts, which ESS does not state here.

bin_edges.description: The bin edges in ascending order; an edge is null when it is NaN or ±inf, which Binary64 does not hold (wave observatory-1 coordinator, 2026-10-21).

modelspec.observatory.MetricSample.title: MetricSample
modelspec.observatory.MetricSample.description: One named metric value at a step, such as MLM accuracy (epic:training-observatory live metric charts, epic:bert-from-scratch evaluation).

value.description: The metric's value; null when it is NaN or ±inf, which Binary64 does not hold (wave observatory-1 coordinator, 2026-10-21).

modelspec.observatory.ParameterStatistic.title: ParameterStatistics
modelspec.observatory.ParameterStatistic.description: The norm and histogram of one parameter's values or gradient at a step, by its stable path (DESIGN.md § 2.3; epic:training-observatory).

norm.description: The norm; null when it is NaN or ±inf, which Binary64 does not hold (wave observatory-1 coordinator, 2026-10-21).

modelspec.observatory.StatisticsSubject.title: StatisticsSubject
modelspec.observatory.StatisticsSubject.description: Whether statistics describe a parameter's values or the gradient of the loss with respect to it (epic:training-observatory parameter/gradient histograms and norms).

modelspec.observatory.StepCompleted.title: StepCompleted
modelspec.observatory.StepCompleted.description: The event of one completed training step (epic:training-observatory), one for each of the steps + 1 losses a run records, steps start_step through start_step + steps in order; step k is the loss after k updates and the last is the loss of the final parameters (DESIGN.md § 8, the `step <k> loss <v>` lines; `train::runner` in modelspec-runtime). Its loss is the loss the CLI prints for that step (DESIGN.md § 8).

step.description: The step number the run reached, as TrainingRun.current_step (DESIGN.md § 6.1 step number).

loss.description: The rank-0 loss value of the step (DESIGN.md § 2.2, § 8); null when the loss is NaN or ±inf, which Binary64 does not hold, as a diverging run records (wave observatory-1 coordinator, 2026-10-21). The CLI prints a `step <k> loss <v>` line on stdout only for step 0, every 50th step and the last step; for a printed step whose loss is null that line names which, `NaN`, `inf` or `-inf`, and for any other step nothing names it (wave observatory-1 coordinator, 2026-10-22).

metrics.description: Metric samples of the step besides the loss; names are unique.

parameters.description: Value and gradient statistics per parameter; the pair (path, subject) is unique, which ESS does not state here. A parameter the loss does not read has no gradient (DESIGN.md § 3.3 step 4).

x-ess-invariants: distinct sample in metrics by sample.name
